events.text:
I scanned the customer master and found 85 likely duplicate pairs. I did not merge any records.

- **73** match on name, address, and tax ID (example: C-1001/C-1440 “Pellham Industrial”).
- **12** match on name and address but have different tax IDs, so they may be separate legal entities (example: C-2210/C-2875 “Ridgeview Holdings”).
- Full list: `duplicates_2026-10-21.csv`.

I asked Morgan Lee to confirm before any merges, because a merge moves all orders and invoices to the surviving record, deletes the other, and cannot be undone.
